tokens.name: gr-page
tokens.usage: Page ground from the Gradio Soft theme (neutral-50 / neutral-950); the app does not set it itself.

tokens.name: gr-text
tokens.usage: Body text from the Gradio Soft theme (neutral-800 / neutral-100): player names, scores, log rows, on gr-page and bk-card in both themes.

tokens.name: bk-blue
tokens.usage: Blue player: its placed squares, remaining pieces, swatch, start-corner outline (A1) and time bar. Same value in both themes. Blue moves first.

tokens.name: bk-yellow
tokens.usage: Yellow player (corner T1). Same in both themes. Only 1.7:1 on bk-empty and 1.9:1 on bk-card in Light: always pair it with the word Yellow or its board position, never alone.

tokens.name: bk-red
tokens.usage: Red player (corner T20). Same in both themes. Red and Green differ by hue, not lightness (1.3:1): always pair a swatch with the color's name.

tokens.name: bk-green
tokens.usage: Green player (corner A20); the shared color in 3-player games. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: bk-empty
tokens.usage: Empty board cell fill.

tokens.name: bk-board
tokens.usage: Board background behind the cell grid (the 1px gutters between cells).

tokens.name: bk-label
tokens.usage: Column letters A–T and row numbers 1–20 around the board, on the page ground. 3.2:1 on bk-board in Light (below 4.5:1 for 10px text); 7.4:1 in Dark.

tokens.name: bk-mark
tokens.usage: Dot marking the squares of the last move, at 85% opacity over a player color. White on bk-yellow is 1.9:1 in Light.

tokens.name: bk-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bk-card: stats, details, table headers, cell lists, reasoning, help. 4.8:1 Light, 6.9:1 Dark.

tokens.name: bk-card
tokens.usage: Surface of status bar, player cards, tray and control buttons.

tokens.name: bk-border
tokens.usage: 1px card borders, table and log row dividers, time-bar track, kind-badge outline, pick hover. Decorative only (1.3:1).

tokens.name: bk-accent
tokens.usage: State emphasis: the player whose turn it is, the finished-game status, the human tray border, the selected piece. 5.2:1 Light, 7.0:1 Dark on bk-card.

tokens.name: bk-danger-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the fallback tag in the move log.

tokens.name: bk-danger-fg
tokens.usage: Error text, fallback tag text, the clock under 5 seconds, and the dashed outline of an illegal placement. On bk-danger-bg 5.8:1 Light, 7.9:1 Dark.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Two heuristic bots, Greedy and Tactician, always play.
styles.usage: Gradio Soft theme body text (text_md); the base every bk- size below scales from.

styles.name: status
styles.usage: Status bar line. Weight 600 once the game is over.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: Human move countdown in the tray; tabular numerals.

styles.name: player-name
styles.usage: Player name in a card head; inherits the body size.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Score at the right of a card head; tabular numerals.

styles.name: log
styles.usage: Move log rows and table cells.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Tray message (fixed at 2 lines so the board never moves), control buttons, notes under tables.

styles.name: detail
styles.usage: Stats, details, color-row labels, cell lists, inline errors. In bk-muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Kind badge, help text, table sub-lines.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Fallback tag in the move log.

styles.name: board-label
styles.usage: Coordinates around the board SVG, in bk-label. SVG units: scales with the board.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Status and badge vertical padding; the turn ring width.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Pick button padding; pick-button border width; control button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between pieces in the tray; log row side padding; message top margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Table cell and log row vertical padding; badge side padding; row gap between remaining pieces; time bar top margin.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Status padding; card-head and control gaps; color-row top margin; table cell side padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Card vertical padding; gap between player cards; control button side padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Card and status side padding.

tokens.name: radius-piece
tokens.usage: Squares of a piece drawn off the board (remaining pieces, picks).

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Time bar, start-corner outline.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Board cells, color swatches.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Board background.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Piece pick buttons, control buttons.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Status bar.

tokens.name: radius-10
tokens.usage: Player cards and the tray.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Kind badge and fallback tag.

tokens.name: shadow-turn
tokens.usage: Second ring on the card of the player who is thinking, doubling its bk-accent border. The code writes it as 0 0 0 1px var(--bk-accent).

tokens.name: board-cell
tokens.usage: Board cell pitch in SVG units (a 22px square plus a 1px gutter each side).

tokens.name: board-margin
tokens.usage: SVG margin holding the coordinates.

tokens.name: board-max-width
tokens.usage: Largest rendered board width; it scales down to fit its column.

tokens.name: piece-cell
tokens.usage: Square pitch of remaining pieces in player cards.

tokens.name: pick-cell
tokens.usage: Square pitch of pieces in the tray.

tokens.name: swatch
tokens.usage: Color swatch width and height.

tokens.name: hand
tokens.usage: Box showing the selected piece in its current orientation.

tokens.name: timebar
tokens.usage: Time bar height.

tokens.name: log-max-height
tokens.usage: The move log scrolls past this height.

tokens.name: opacity-anchor
tokens.usage: Corner-point dots while a person is to move.

tokens.name: opacity-last
tokens.usage: Last-move dot.

tokens.name: opacity-inactive
tokens.usage: Card of a player with no colors left in play.

tokens.name: opacity-preview
tokens.usage: Legal placement preview on the board.

tokens.name: opacity-out
tokens.usage: Color row of a color that is out.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Piece picks with no legal placement.
